integrity: Exact standard-library Python certificate enumerates all combinatorial cases and confirms finite incidence claims; all-field point counts also proved by rational-line inclusion-exclusion. No independent audit or expert certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Not a theorem on all six-point subsets over larger fields or on scheme-theoretic specialization multiplicities. Classical ten-exterior-line geometry itself is prior work. Unindexed equivalent finite-geometry calculations may exist.
scientific_scope: Distinct six rational points of a smooth conic over the field of five elements; 60 combinatorial Pascal hexagons; reduced exterior-line divisor and its extension-field zeta functions.
title: Sixfold Pascal collapse onto the ten exterior lines of the complete \(\mathbb F_5\)-conic
